summary.intent: Debug and fix 7 failing copilot-cli E2E tests from CI run #22747075400, then clean up into a single commit and open a PR.
summary.outcome: All 7 original failures fixed (42/43 passing); PR #632 opened on alex/copilot-e2e-fix with three root-cause fixes and a transient-retry improvement for gpt-4.1 Edit tool flakes.

repo: NewTmuxSession (e2e/agents/tmux.go) only forwards PATH into the tmux session; all other agent-specific env vars must be passed explicitly via a nested `env KEY=VAL ...` command.

CI env vars (CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS) cause Copilot CLI to suppress its interactive TUI prompt entirely; they must be stripped via unsetEnv. Gemini and Droid agents already do this — copilot-cli was missing it.
Copilot CLI v0.0.422 requires a .github/copilot-instructions.md to exist in the repo; without it, non-interactive mode degrades (Edit tool omits old_str) and interactive mode blocks on a notice.

The IsTransientError + errScenarioRestart pattern only fires when err != nil; silent exit-0 failures (Copilot's Edit tool returning zero changes) need a separate synthetic error raised inside RunPrompt.
Agent-specific test repo setup lives in SetupRepo (e2e/testutil/repo.go ~line 77); droid gets settings, opencode gets config — copilot now gets a stub copilot-instructions.md.

Copilot's Edit tool may self-correct within a single session run; the +0/-0 transient retry must be gated on both 'old_str is required' in stdout AND 'Total code changes: +0 -0' in stderr to avoid false-positive restarts.
The copilot-cli agent was introduced in branch alex/add-copilot-agent at commit b2a7603, not yet on main at the time of the worktree — the fix branch had to be based off that commit.

code.finding: NewTmuxSession always prepends its own `env PATH=<shellQuote(os.Getenv(PATH))>` to the command string, making PATH in agent-provided envArgs redundant (harmless but noisy).

Synthetic error for silent exit-0 Edit tool failure: checks out.Stdout for 'old_str is required' AND out.Stderr for 'Total code changes: +0 -0' before surfacing an error; dual-gate prevents false positives when Copilot self-corrects internally.

COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN must be validated before the tmux session is created; silently skipping it (empty-string check) causes a late, cryptic auth failure inside Copilot rather than an early actionable error.

SendKeys error inside the startup dialog dismissal loop was silently discarded; if tmux dies mid-loop the resulting error message says 'waiting for startup prompt' rather than 'failed to send Enter key', misdirecting debugging.

Established pattern for agent-specific repo bootstrap: guard on agent.Name() and write files/config before returning the repo path. Copilot's .github/copilot-instructions.md stub follows the same structure as the opencode config block.

workflow: Never run `git reset --soft HEAD~N` with uncommitted working tree changes — the soft reset restores the index from those N commits, silently clobbering newer unstaged edits. Stage all changes before squashing.
`git add <relative-path>` can fail inside a worktree due to CWD mismatch; use the absolute path or verify CWD before staging.
Download CI artifacts into e2e/artifacts/ (project convention) rather than /tmp so they persist and are accessible by path across tool calls.
False-positive transient retries are worse than no retries: they burn through the scenario attempt budget and can trigger upstream rate limits, turning 1 failure into 4+.

When a local reproduction attempt shows an issue doesn't reproduce (e.g., CI=true didn't block Copilot interactivity locally), trust the CI data over the local test and keep investigating environmental differences.
Automated PR reviewers (Cursor bot, Copilot bot) flagged the redundant PATH forwarding and token-in-ps-args concerns that the manual code review also caught — useful as a cross-check.

friction: Initial misdiagnosis: blamed prompt regex not matching Copilot v0.0.422 TUI; user had to redirect attention to the 'No copilot instructions found' message.
Second misdiagnosis: guessed CI/GITHUB_ACTIONS stripping would fix interactive timeouts; local test didn't reproduce but the fix happened to work in CI for unconfirmed reasons.
git reset --soft lost working tree edits (old_str retry logic) silently — required re-implementing and amending the commit.
User had to remind to download artifacts into e2e/artifacts/ rather than /tmp.
Multiple CI round-trips (5 triggered runs) needed to converge on root causes due to inability to reproduce CI environment locally.
False-positive retry caused a regression from 1 failure to 4 failures in one run, requiring an additional fix-and-rerun cycle.
open_items: TestLineAttributionReasonable failed due to a corrupted Copilot CLI installation (truncated index.js) on the runner — unrelated to the PR changes; expected to clear on rerun.
COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN appears in `ps` output via `env KEY=VAL` args — flagged by Copilot bot review; deferred as acceptable in ephemeral CI runners but worth revisiting for long-lived environments.
The gpt-4.1 Edit tool's 'old_str is required' flake is ultimately a model-side issue; the retry mechanism is a workaround, not a fix — worth tracking upstream with GitHub.
Final validation CI run (22749960064) showed 42/43; a full clean run to confirm 43/43 was still pending when session ended.
